title: Haan Hai Yakeen

hinglish.verse1:
Kyun main daroon jab jaanu main ye
Tu wafadar hai sada ke liye
Har intehaan mein sambhala tune
Pehle kiya jo tune, karega phirse
hinglish.chorus:
Yeshu haan hai yakeen
Har zarurat ka jawab hai tu
Yeshu haan hai yakeen
Karega tu chamatkar mere khatir
Haan hai yakeen, haan hai yakeen
Yeshu haan hai yakeen
hinglish.verse2:
Tu jo kahe poora karega
Tere hi haathon mein zindagi meri
Chaahe jo ho, tu na haare kabhi
Tere waade Prabhu hai taakat meri
Tere waade Prabhu hai taakat meri

hinglish.bridge:
Tera samarth, samarth Yeshu tera samarth
